headline: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centers abroad
pages: President Trump said Friday that he will ban US companies from building AI data centers overseas, threatening a "tremendous tax" for firms that do. "We're going to keep it all in this country," he said, giving little detail and admitting he had not yet told his own team. It is unclear whether the idea will become policy or how it would be enforced. Meta and Google have already agreed to build data centers abroad. Data centers were a central issue in the Nov. 3 midterms, and many Democrats who promised tougher rules won. Earlier this week Washington said firms will need a license to buy advanced chips, a move that affects Southeast Asian countries building data centers. Source: BBC
